# StreetInterviewVideos.com

> StreetInterviewVideos.com is a video production company that makes street
> interview videos, UGC-style ads, and authentic short-form content for brands
> running TikTok, Instagram, Reels, Shorts, and Meta campaigns. Real people.
> Real reactions. Built for the platforms your audience actually uses.

Canonical domain: https://streetinterviewvideos.com

## What we do

Every campaign starts with one binary decision: scripted or unscripted.

- **Scripted street interviews** — Actor-led. Brand-controlled message. Cleaner
  edit. Reliable hook delivery. Fastest path to a hero ad you can scale on cold
  paid traffic.
- **Unscripted street interviews** — Real strangers. Real reactions. No script,
  no actors. Highest trust ceiling in the format. Longest durability in an ad
  account.

The same shoot can power paid video ads, social media content, testimonial-style
proof, branded video campaigns, product launch creative, or real-reaction ad
concepts — we figure out which structure fits on the kickoff call.

## How brands work with us

1. Book a 15-minute discovery call ([Calendly](https://calendly.com/brandlaunchmediaagency/30min)).
2. We recommend scripted vs unscripted based on the goal, product, and timeline.
3. Production runs in as little as 5–10 days for most projects (up to 21 for
   bigger campaigns).
4. Delivery is vertical 9:16, captioned and uncaptioned exports, multiple hook
   variations, raw footage, and ad-account-ready filenames.

## Locations

Primarily New York and Los Angeles. We accommodate specific events and
brand-requested locations on a case-by-case basis.
